questions.text: What does a high and steady Total Value Locked (TVL) suggest about a DeFi protocol?
options: The protocol is likely trusted by users
The protocol has no smart contract risk
questions.explanation: High steady TVL indicates that users have deposited assets, showing trust in the protocol.

questions.text: True or false: Lack of third‑party audit is a major red flag when evaluating a DeFi protocol.
questions.explanation: Independent audits help verify code safety; missing them signals risk.

questions.text: Which governance structure poses the greatest risk to a DeFi protocol's treasury?
options: Voting power is spread across the community
questions.explanation: If founders control all voting power, they can unilaterally move funds without community approval.

questions.text: True or false: A healthy DeFi community features developers who answer technical questions openly.
questions.explanation: Transparent communication about bugs and downtime is a sign of a healthy project.
